note: Output is in the as-mapped frame; wall planes are arbitrarily oriented. Use each wall's plane/basis to work in 2D. walls.pcd label = wall id; collision_boxes.pcd label = obstacle id (see obstacles[].id).
obstacle_policy: Every cluster protruding past a wall plane is emitted as a collision object.
obstacle_reliability_note: CAUTION: worst wall spread p99 = 67 mm exceeds --min-protrusion = 30 mm. Boxes with above_wall_scatter=false protrude less than the wall's own reconstruction scatter and may be map error rather than real objects -- filter on that flag if you need only confident obstacles. Root fix: hand-eye calibrate camera_link->link_eef and re-map.
